notes.title: Auction Patch 1
notes.notes:
Howdy, pardner!
There’s a new patch in town 🤠
Feel free to join the Discord server to discuss this update or look at sneak peeks for the next one! 😎 

This patch is the first part of our ongoing auction rebalance, we'd appreciate feedback along the way 🫡 
Changelog

Balance changes
Made it less likely for parts that have already been bought to appear in the auction again.
Improvements
Auction intro animation is now skipped after the first round. Should make the matches snappier.

Brought the tumbling tumbleweed back to the main menu 🎉
Bugfixes
Player shadows no longer linger mysteriously where the player died.



Please report issues you find in the bug report discussion thread or on the discord, it is greatly helpful to us developers 👍
We will continue fixing bugs and improving the game, so stay tuned – and remember to join the discord 😎

notes.title: The Explosive Update (v0.5.0)
notes.notes:
Howdy, pardner!

There’s a new and explosive update in town 🤠
Feel free to join the Discord server to discuss this update or look at sneak peeks for the next one! 😎

Grand Canyon

The Grand Canyon is a former military base turned dynamite (barrel) factory!
Zoom across the map on conveyor belts, or watch your opponents' suprise as you flip the switch that makes them go in reverse and send them to meet their maker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/01492a52fd855549bcb4799dea2760e82e7a6fc1.png

🧨 The BOOM-bardier 🧨

The BOOM-bardier launches sticky sticks of dynamite that you can detonate at will by pressing the zoom button. Place your dynamites strategically and make your enemies tremble!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/5c5cd40d8f71d6747ae8fb14fc7a623c6b79cee5.gif

🧱 The brick barrel 🧱

Presenting the BRICK BARREL! It shoots BRICKS that inherit your velocity, EXPLODE on hit and deal more damage the faster you move!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/085ff22561e2e94d99e8a271b34bf4a32750a1c7.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/8d291e1fe0702b3ceadf150ac93c47bac5209d8b.gif

UI overhaul

We overhauled the UI with slightly more stylish buttons and backgrounds:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/db1d8f83091a813fff0003493858b2fd64e205b2.png

PS: Some menus may look a little odd on some screens at the moment.

Try weapon parts in the tutorial

We fixed a few bugs that plagued weapon switching, and you'll now be able to try any combination of weapon part that you want in the tutorial map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/09eaa1eed2df74807340b56a5ac6ecef039353b1.gif

Changelog

Features


   New map: Grand Canyon
   New barrel: The BOOM-bardier 🧨
   New barrel: The BRICK barrel 🧱
   Spray cans! 🎨
   Added santa hats that will make a comeback next winter 🎅


Improvements


   Fancier victory screen; now with animated outline! 🏆
   Players should be more visible at distance now 🔭
   Made fan particles look much more like wind (and fixed a few quirks) 🌬
   Added wind particles for the skies as well!
   Doubled the performance of the entire game by disabling superfluous cameras 😅
   Improved performance of decals through GPU instantiation
   Made menu buttons more fancy
   Altered menu scene layout
   Used the loading screen background for other UI elements as well
   Added loading screen transition animation ⏲
   Added lots of new crimes and tips
   Gave the cowbots more texture 👔
   Gave the healthbar more flair with more colors, animations and damage numbers 🏥
   Made the damage popups for crits more impactful 💢
   Overhauled scoreboards with CRT background and more sound effects
   Added overheat sound for lawn mower 📯
   Improved trash impact shockwave (it doesn't look quite as trashy anymore) 🗑
   Added screen shake from explosions
   Added weapon bobbing
   Added more platforms and cover to The Pit
   Added grafitti decals in various spots in the existing maps
   Textured the shacks in Crater Town
   Made spectator cam start out looking towards what killed you


Bug fixes


   Fixed the oddly long-standing issue where firing the Big F**ing Lazur did not deduct ammo
   Fixed decals being able to attach to various bullet hole decals
   Fixed loading screen not appearing when joining a lobby
   Fixed some issues related to switching weapons
   Fixed AIs not yielding while leading 🔨
   Fixed some glitches with the yield countdown
   Fixed telescope sight persisting after death in spectator mode
   Fixed several issues with sticky projectiles
   Made it possible to jump off of explosive barrels
   Increased maximum number of players in online matches back to 4 (whoops)
   Prevented the loading screen from blocking level cards



Please report issues you find in the bug report discussion thread, it is greatly helpful to us developers 👍
We will continue fixing bugs and improving the game, so stay tuned – and remember to join the discord 😎

notes.title: The Voice Line Update (v0.4.2)
notes.notes:
Howdy, pardner!

There’s a new update in town 🤠
Feel free to join the Discord server to discuss this update or look at sneak peeks for the next one! 😎

The new MacOs version has not been properly tested (as we don't have any mac users on the dev team), so please give us feedback if you experience any bugs!

Voice lines and SFXs

Each cowbot color now has its own voice, with responses to panshots, falling down in The Pit, being set on fire and landing a kill. Thanks to the voice actors who submitted their hilarious impressions in the contest at our launch party!

We have also added a lot more sound effects to the game for better immersion, the most notable being walking sounds that change based on what you are walking on (sand/wood/metal), and clicking noises when trying to shoot with no ammo.

Headshots

Hitting the head of an opposing cowbot now counts as a headshot with extra damage. This applies to most hitscan barrels, and any barrel with the telescope extension equipped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/9950281744d0a5cbe4ef080d976fe5cfba658774.gif

Crosshairs
We also upgraded the crosshair, with new variations for different projectile types, including a very special hat crosshair. The crosshair will also adapt to other parts of your gun, like indicating no spread for guns with the telescope extension, or by increasing crosshair size for the enlarger extension.

We also added a hitmark which triggers anytime you cause someone damage, which is separate from just hitting someone directly.

Gun part improvements

The Pan
The pan extension got buffed with the ability to block explosion damage, allowing for much safer explosion jumps:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/48c15f3c1fe7b7ededc30b21360741c02c2d9266.gif

It also got a new interaction with leaping: Bunnyleap with the pan in the air, then stick it in the ground and crouch to enter a speedy slide:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/f350f0a975dfd5149c4d3626410bf9c9f869b486.gif

The pan has also received some miscellaneous overhauls like being better at reflecting BFL laser beams and better pan skating jumps.

Tether
The tether body now works properly in online play, making it possible to unplug your opponents reliably to stop them from firing.

Rebindable keys

Keyboard players can now rebind their keys in the settings menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880302/823bb20ba282a44e08698c420ce718a689489e6d.gif

Support for gamepad rebinding will come later, along with a better UI.


Changelog

Features


   Added voicelines with unique voices for each cowbot
   Added UI for rebindable keyboard keys
   Added headshots and critical hits for achieving headshots
   Added a hitmark animation for anytime you deal damage
   Added sound effects when walking on different surfaces
   Added sound effects for soda cans
   Added sound effects for trying to shoot with no ammo
   Added new achievement for "The point&click adventure"-gun
   Added MacOs support


Improvements


   Improved crosshair hit animation
   Improved synchronizing players when playing online. There is now far less jittering over bad connections.
   Improved jumping when pan sliding


Balance changes


   Buffed the Pan extension, giving it explosive resistance of aimed correctly. In addition pan sliding has been improved, and a "super slide" has been added. The blocking hitboxes have become slightly larger and thus better at blocking.


Bug fixes


   Fixed an issue where bullet and explosion decals could stick to players and pan, allowing them to be moved around
   Fixed an issue where players who watched the entire intro without pressing a button couldn't move when it ended
   Fixed an issue where the tether plug could be unplugged for one player but not for another player
   Fixed an issue where the killfeed wouldn't be displayed for non-host clients in an online match
   Fixed an issue where the revolver body would play its reload animation twice if spammed with a slowly firing barrel like the coil or BFL
   Fixed an issue where AIs in a multiplayer game would not pathfind correctly to yield zones on clients



Please report issues you find in the bug report discussion thread, it is greatly helpful to us developers 👍
We will continue fixing bugs and improving the game, so stay tuned – and remember to join the discord 😎

notes.title: The Community Update (v0.4.0)
notes.notes:
Howdy, pardner!
There’s a new update in town 🤠
This time we've fixed lots of your feedback and worked on several new features.

But first: We've created a Discord server where players can plan sessions and follow the development process. We look forward to seeing you there!


Weapons

The Enlarger

Introducing the Enlarger, an extension that turns projectiles humongous:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/80405fa116911a99d18478d297f9930272427456.gif

Telescope changes

The Telescope extension got another unique trait: It makes all projectile types shoot straight.
With it equipped, hats become precise missiles, and the coil lightning fires in a straight line.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/a04586ad0806ffeb2066debc4aa27a69b7854f4f.gif

Tether changes

In response to various bits of feedback, we reworked the Tether body so that its wire now attaches by throwing it onto a surface instead of freezing your movement and placing it down right where you stand. This should make it much more forgiving to use.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/6fb235a2dddc7e98055407314d392e07cba18ac0.gif


Matchmaking and gamemodes

For easier matchmaking, we added a queuing system that places you in the first available lobby with your chosen gamemode. This will make it easier to find matches, even with few active players.

We added a system for customizable gamemodes, and the official gamemodes are now:


  First to 30 Chips: Be the first to win with 30 chips.
  Six Rounds: Get the most kills during six rounds to win.
  Three Strikes: The original mode. Win three rounds to win the match.


For additional variety, you can customize the win/stop condition, chip rewards and starting weapon:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/a41681eb43268884eaea0c5e0703d92aa5a2522d.png
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/6a9d008e3fbaf70f03d654db7956cc16ccdfde64.png

On the topic of customization, we added settings for look sensitivity and field of view.

Visual overhaul

Grand Canyon becomes The Pit

We overhauled Grand Canyon with new props, better lighting and improved design.

Before
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/bedd24edf08cd3568619d062dbf8ab74df7cd62c.png

After
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/8eb7ec1a55942da45a7a79d3503f7f6aa3f845d6.png

Better explosions 🧨

Explosive barrels got a new model, flashier explosions and a shockwave effect:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44880302/c19af26fc8f31f55a6cab4c79f8e692f47287cf3.gif


Changelog

We have made lots of other improvements beyond the ones we highlighted above. This is the full list.

Features


  Queuing system
  Customizable gamemodes
  Two new gamemodes: First to 30 Chips and Six Rounds
  New extension: The Enlarger
  Polished extension: Telescope
  Polished body: Tether
  Players can agree to skip auctions
  Kill feed
  Pause menu
  More settings
  More achievements


Improvements


  You can now use your mouse to navigate the menu 🎉
  Added mine carts, rail tracks and other props to Grand Canyon (now The Pit)
  Fixed lighting in The Pit
  Made shadow textures look better
  Improved AI movement in The Pit
  Render better outlines on hats and other particles
  Made explosions and fire trails glow
  Added shockwave effect to explosions
  Replaced explosive barrel model with a more explosive-looking one
  Polished unplugging animation and other visuals for the tether body
  Players no longer block the item descriptions in auctions
  Populated lobby scene with some cozy props
  Populated auction scene with some cozy props
  Added round number to scoreboards
  Added chip pickup listing to scoreboards
  Added version number to landing menu
  Added lots of new crimes for the scoreboards
  Added LOD for player and explosive barrel models
  Added sound effect for jumping


Balance changes


  Added a chip cap (20 or 30) so players don't hoard hundreds of chips
  Added more cover to The Pit
  Made all projectiles travel in a straight line with the Telescope extension
  Tether body now works by throwing the plug to place it, instead of locking you in place
  Nerfed shotgun damage
  Nerfed cannon damage
  Nerfed bullet speed increase from the DDR body
  Removed damage bonus from the DDR body
  Buffed Lawn Mower with damage bonus
  Nerfed bullet speed to default for the Sodie Popper and Tether bodies
  Buffed coil barrel accuracy
  Buffed laser barrel with thicker shots


Bug fixes


  Weapon building would not time out if someone readied and then unreadied
  Weapon building would crash if a player had 6 or more of one kind of gun part
  Lots of other tiny bugs were fixed as part of rewriting things



This is a huge update that might bring lots of new bugs that we aren’t aware of.
Please report issues you find in the bug report discussion thread, it is greatly helpful to us developers 👍
We will continue fixing bugs and improving the game, so stay tuned – and remember to join the discord 😎

notes.title: Post-launch bugfix patch
notes.notes:
Howdy, pardner!
There's a new update in town 🤠

This update fixes the following bugs:


 Wins from the previous match carried over to the next match (reported by Connorses)
 Chips were reset at the end of each match, so that only chips won in that match actually counted
 Each individual shot in the shotgun spray counted as a kill, leading to some players getting overly rich
 Similarly, hitting with multiple shots would result in ridiculous knockback
 The camera could end up in odd orientations, making it impossible to aim/move and seeming like the controls got swapped (reported by TK2236)
 Ending a match with the floppy sniper extension could lead to your crosshair being off-kilter in the next round (reported by Connorses)
 Jumping onto flying platforms could instantly kill players - they are removed until a fix is found


Thanks to Connorses and TK2236 for reporting some of these bugs!
Please report other issues you find in the bug report discussion thread, it is greatly helpful to us developers 👍
We will continue fixing bugs and improving the game, stay tuned 😎
